item.description:
Scriberman 1.1.3

What’s new

  • Read, search, and play passages from the full transcript directly in session details.
  • Undo and redo changes to session titles, tags, and speakers.
  • Access recording, playback, session actions, and Find through menus and keyboard shortcuts.
  • Play and copy transcript passages with keyboard and VoiceOver controls.
  • Hear microphone and app audio together in both ears in new recordings.

Fixes

  • The Stop button stays visible as the live transcript grows.
  • Failed title saves now show an alert and preserve the previous title.
